I implemented TTL support and added a testable now() option.

Summary of changes
- Updated src/lru.ts:
  - Constructor now accepts an optional options object: { ttl?: number, now?: () => number }.
  - Per-entry TTL override supported via set(key, value, ttlMs?).
  - Entries store an expiresAt timestamp (or undefined for never expire).
  - Expired entries are purged lazily on operations (get, has, delete, size, keys) and proactively before evicting when inserting.
  - now() is configurable for testability (defaults to Date.now).

Behavior notes
- If no TTL is provided (neither in constructor nor in set), entries never expire — existing tests' behavior is preserved.
- Expired entries behave as if absent: get returns undefined, has returns false, they don't count in size and are not included in keys().
- When inserting and the cache is full, expired entries are removed first; only if still full is the oldest live entry evicted.

I ran the test suite; all tests passed (7 tests). If you'd like, I can add unit tests specifically covering TTL behavior and the now() option.
